lastCompletedStory.title: Gate plannability on non-empty acceptance criteria

openQuestions: ADR-0051 blast radius confirmed with the operator: CAM-432, CAM-441 and CAM-447 stopped being plannable the moment this landed (verified via the AC6 end-to-end oracle: bad=[] now, meaning they are no longer reported as plannable at all). No grandfather clause was added, per the ADR. Their recovery path is `cam issue demote <id>` then `cam spec <id>`.
nextStoryContext: isPlannable (src/issues/plannable.ts) now requires non-empty spec.acceptanceCriteria in addition to stage/status/blocked. isSpecifiedOpen (Layer 1, used by rank.ts/gate.ts) is untouched and stays criteria-agnostic by design -- do not fold the acceptance-criteria gate into it. Any future test fixture building a specified/open IssueEntry must include a spec: { acceptanceCriteria: [...], scope, gotchas: [], domainTerms: [] } or it silently becomes not-plannable under the new gate.
